redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/benchmark.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: Error: Cannot find module '<outside-repo>'; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; no ignored dependency directory linked from the project root; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home); deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

outcome.technical: New skills/architecture-map/evals/benchmark/grade-benchmark.mjs (Node 18, ESM, zero deps): `node grade-benchmark.mjs <run-dir> <A|B|C> <tool> <checklist.json> [--draw-c4-plot <plot.py>]`. It ports the private reference grader's five checks rule for rule. E1: checklist terms as case-insensitive substrings of the text-extension corpus of the files `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` reports. E2: archmap sequences with 2 or more steps; draw-c4 model.json flows, or the model draw-c4's plot.py extracts when --draw-c4-plot is given; otherwise sequenceDiagram blocks + headings of flow files and flow-named headings + flow-like .omm perspectives, with the tree found wherever it sits. E3: archmap nodes with evidence[]; draw-c4 nodes with a path-like token, kinds external/person/focus excluded, levels keyed by id; omm description.md, elements described as External excluded; cc-codemaps component-table rows, route tables and tables keyed by path skipped. PATHLIKE accepts folder paths, and a leading / counts as a route. E4: docs/architecture or the documented location. E5: exit-code. Python semantics are reproduced where the output depends on them: Unicode \w/\b, universal newlines, splitlines, strip('|'), truthiness, repr() of lists in evidence, json.dump indent=2 ensure_ascii with no trailing newline. Exits 2 with the usage on bad args, an unreadable checklist, a missing <run-dir>/repo or a failing git status. Deliberate deviations: the home-dir plot.py glob is replaced by --draw-c4-plot; a not-graded check's evidence reads 'not graded: <reason>' instead of 'None ()'/'None/None ()'; git status stdout only, not stdout+stderr; draw-c4 E3 uses the in-memory model E2 kept rather than re-reading a possibly stale draw-c4-model.json. Differential check in the scratchpad (diffcheck.mjs, the Python spec vs the port on 9 synthetic cells): grading.json and the summary line byte-identical on 6; the other 3 differ only in the not-graded evidence text. Tests: tests/benchmark.test.mjs gains b24..b31 after b23. Fixtures: tests/fixtures/benchmark/checklist.json and shapes.json, made-up components only; each case builds a temp run dir (git init, base commit, artifacts written uncommitted, exit-code). Docs: PROTOCOL.md names the grader and its command in the Pass rate bullet and the Expectations section, says run-candidate.sh does the placeholder substitution and passes the headless flags (it was 'the harness'), and its Runs section says the 13 cells were graded with this grader's rules. BENCHMARK.md 'How each number was produced' names the grader command and link, and points the headless flags at run-candidate.sh (tracked). Also corrected in both docs: the file-reference check never verified that the path exists, so the text now says 'a file or folder path' and PROTOCOL says existence is not checked. Runs: node --test tests/denylist.test.mjs tests/benchmark.test.mjs exit 0 (34 pass); node --test exit 0 (496 pass, 0 fail). New files staged with git add so the denylist scan sees them; nothing committed. Edits to PROTOCOL.md, BENCHMARK.md and one fix in the grader went through python3 in Bash, following the session's auto-mode instruction to prefer Bash: the Write tool had turned \u2028/\u2029 into literal characters, which broke a regex literal. No tool call was refused. Dependants: BENCHMARK.md -> CHANGELOG.md, README.md, docs/roadmap.md, skills/architecture-map/evals/README.md still correct (they link the page, whose tables did not change); tests/readme.test.mjs and benchmark.test.mjs b21/b23 green. PROTOCOL.md -> summary.json and run-candidate.sh unchanged and still correct; readme/benchmark tests green. tests/benchmark.test.mjs -> tests/evals.test.mjs green; docs/roadmap.md, BENCHMARK.md and the evals README still describe it correctly (they cite b21/b23, unchanged). tests/fixtures/benchmark -> the listed dependants match the basename 'benchmark' loosely (evidence/benchmark, cost-profile fixtures); none reads the new fixture files; all green.
